# Update Plan

Revise `docs/ai/current-plan.md` with clear scope and verification.

## When to Use

- Start new scoped work
- Change scope mid-session
- Clarify steps/verification

## Procedure

1. Read current plan and requested change.
2. Produce concise scope, steps, verification, blockers.
3. Apply updates to `docs/ai/current-plan.md`.

## Required Sections

- Title + status
- Scope
- Steps
- Verification
- Dependencies/blockers
- Decision rationale

## How to Use

Use when plan scope or verification needs revision.
